hooks.text: Raat 11 baje cafe ka customer WhatsApp karta, aap reply nahi karte?
Cafe owner, pehle reel ke baad abhi bhi enquiries unanswered?
Main iske baare mein galat tha…
Aapke cafe ki chatbot abhi bhi galat jawab de rahi hai...

beats.visual: Phone screen showing WhatsApp notification at 11 PM, owner ignoring it

beats.line: Log sirf script likhte hain, lekin purani ya conflicting info se bot galat jawab deta hai?
Par kya aapka bot sach samajh pa raha hai?
WhatsApp bot common questions answer karta hai, natural tone mein reply karta hai, isliye bot robot jaisa nahi lagta.
beats.visual: WhatsApp chat UI showing bot answering a query in friendly tone
steps: Bot natural tone mein reply karta

beats.line: Ek study mein 80,000 galat details dekhe gaye; aapka bot galat info dekar trust kho sakta hai.
Agar aapki cafe ki WhatsApp replies miss ho rahi hain, comment BOT, main DM mein ek checklist bhejunga, taaki aap dekh saken fit hai ya nahi.

master_script.linkedin_english: Many cafe owners lose enquiries because their chatbot gives wrong answers. Using a list of the 20 most common questions and a natural script prevents hallucinations. Comment “BOT” to receive a checklist of the 10 essential questions for your WhatsApp bot.

marketing.gets: a one-page checklist: the 10 questions a WhatsApp reply bot should answer for your business, so you can see if it fits

facts.claim: Around 80% of Indian consumers now use AI chatbots for complaints, recommendations, and self‑help.
facts.title: Best Prompts for Building Your First AI Chatbot - Step by Step

facts.claim: Most made‑up chatbot answers on small‑business sites stem from missing, outdated, or conflicting content, or from vague questions.
facts.title: Why Chatbots Make Things Up, and How to Stop It ChatBento

facts.claim: The US National Institute of Standards and Technology defines hallucination as confidently stated but erroneous or false content.
facts.title: Why Chatbots Make Things Up, and How to Stop It ChatBento

facts.claim: Chatbots sound robotic mainly because the scripts are stiff and formal, not because of the underlying technology.
facts.title: Why Your Chatbot Sounds Like a Robot (And How to Fix the Script)

facts.claim: Starting with the 20 most common customer questions and providing accurate answers helps prevent hallucinations and improves chatbot performance.
facts.title: What an AI chatbot can, and cannot, do for a small business in India Omm Sai Online

facts.claim: More than half of the 80,000‑plus errors logged in a study were invented specific details the company never published.
facts.title: What AI Gets Wrong About B2B Brands: Accuracy Study Resonance

facts.claim: When a bot says 'I don’t have that information,' it is not hallucinating; it is correctly indicating lack of data.
facts.title: Why Chatbots Make Things Up, and How to Stop It ChatBento

facts.claim: Language models generate plausible answers based on learned patterns, so without specific info they may guess common industry practices.
facts.title: Why Chatbots Make Things Up, and How to Stop It ChatBento
